notes.subject: אנוש חצי
notes.rationale: 'my arrow/wound is mortal-incurable' — KJV 'my wound is incurable' vs YLT 'mortal is mine arrow'; חץ i spia, tasol hia em i birua bilong spia

notes.subject: על משפטי אכזב
notes.rationale: 'Am I lying about my right?' (kwesten) vs 'despite my right I am counted a liar' (ASV/JPS) — gramat i gat tupela lait

notes.subject: ⟨mi⟩
notes.rationale: posessiv 'bilong mi' long birua — Hibru i gat em long חצי (mi), tasol Tok Pisin i lainim klia

translation: Long kot bilong mi ol tok mi giaman; birua bilong ⟨mi⟩ i no inap halivim, mi nogat rong.
